moments.text: Infrared sensor view of ground with field edges and bright patches sliding past. A bright white spot sits just right of and below the crosshair.
Bright cloud sweeps in from the left; the white spot passes in front of light and dark cloud below and right of the crosshair.
The spot rises to the upper right of the crosshair against darker cloud.
The picture flashes white, black, then light grey for about a third of a second.
A new, wider-looking view over cloud: the spot, now smaller, sits above and right of the crosshair.
The spot moves down past the right of the crosshair toward the lower left over bright cloud.
